title: Scenario 1: Greenfield (Advanced Analytics Aggregator)
raw_prompt: Implement an advanced Analytics Aggregator service for the URL shortener that collects daily click counts, tracks top referrers, identifies browser/device breakdown, and provides a time-series query API.
user_stories: As an API consumer, I want to implement an advanced analytics aggregator service for the url shortener that collects daily click counts, tracks top... so that the system reliably fulfills the request with low latency.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid inputs, When the API is invoked, Then the response status must be 200/201 and match schema.
Given invalid or malicious inputs, When the API is invoked, Then the request must be safely rejected with appropriate error code.
Given high concurrency, When requests are executed, Then latency P99 must remain < 50ms without data corruption.
Criterion 1: Capture click timestamp, IP, referrer, and user-agent.
Criterion 2: Provide aggregation by date, device category, and top referrers.
assumptions: Capture click timestamp, IP, referrer, and user-agent.
Provide aggregation by date, device category, and top referrers.
